Is TAGRA officially partnered with DKV?
TAGRA imports data from the DKV LIVE® SFTP service using your own DKV credentials. This is a technical interoperability feature, not a formal partnership or endorsement.

Is the DKV LIVE® import included in my TAGRA licence?

Yes. The Data Import feature (including DKV LIVE® connectivity) is part of every current TAGRA licence at no extra cost. You only pay your normal TAGRA licence fee and your normal DKV LIVE® subscription — nothing more.
Which TAGRA versions support DKV LIVE?

All current TAGRA versions — TAGRA 1, 2, 4, 6 and MAX — support DKV LIVE import from version 345 onwards. The version number is shown at the bottom of the TAGRA window. Updates are included in your annual licence.
Where do I get my DKV LIVE credentials?
From your DKV Mobility account manager or sales representative. TAGRA needs a valid SFTP username and password for the DKV LIVE server.
How often should TAGRA fetch data from DKV LIVE?
We recommend at least once a day (interval 1d). That keeps your data current and ensures you are well within the 28-day and 90-day legal download windows.
